  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/ha/pair/{node_id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Set a node's display name and/or the address its peer should use.

Works for either node from either node. An empty string clears an override
and hands the field back to discovery, which is how an operator undoes a
wrong address without having to know what the derived value was.
